title: Capture ingestion
responsibility: Validates a check capture index, rejects redirected or oversized evidence, hashes files within capture and record budgets, and returns record-ready captures or explicit failures.

inputs.name: gatherCaptures.directory
inputs.description: Evidence directory containing the capture index and the flat files named by valid index lines.

inputs.name: gatherCaptures.recordPath
inputs.description: Record-relative prefix prepended to each admitted filename.

inputs.name: gatherCaptures.limits
inputs.description: Optional maximum bytes per capture and across this verification record; absent limits do not cap bytes.

inputs.name: gatherCaptures.scope
inputs.description: Optional shared RecordBudget and trusted run root; the root is used to reject redirected evidence ancestry.

outputs.name: gatherCaptures
outputs.description: Gathered record-ready captures plus explicit failure strings; malformed lines, missing files, symlinks and over-budget files are not admitted.
